outcome: Prevalence of myths regarding room ventilation (MRV) during the postpartum period
cohort: 355 postpartum women at the outpatient clinic of Mother and Child Hospital (MCH), Al-Qassim, Saudi Arabia
finding: Prevalence of MRV was high (80%) among women with only primary education, but lower (13%) among those with high school and college education; MRV was also associated with occupation and parity, highlighting the need for health education to dispel these myths.
mod_finding: 78% of the study participants underwent a Cesarean section.
